items.description:

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 3 at 10:06AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A stronger weather system is expected to move into the panhandle
Saturday into Sunday, bringing periods of moderate to heavy rain.
The peak of heavier rainfall is forecast to occur overnight Saturday
into Sunday, when rain rates could exceed 0.15 inches per hour.

Total rainfall accumulations for the event are expected to be
between 1.5 and 3.0 inches, with the greatest amounts in the central
panhandle. Upwards of 5 inches is possible for higher elevations.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 3 at 8:17AM AKDT until October 4 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts near 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island, City and Borough of Sitka, Prince of Wales
Island, and Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...From 7 PM this evening to 10 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...These winds will be caused by a strong front
that will move across the region Saturday night.

Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
